- 47 ports x 1764 lanes -> combinatorial explosion above 2209 route candidates.
- Network density 163.2% across 47 ports increases routing difficulty.
- Total demand 276,447 TEU requires capacity balancing across 0 services.

Decomposition Rationale: ~15 ports per region enables scalable 3-agent optimization.
